title: Shortage Policy
description: What happens to an order line whose requested quantity cannot be covered because no stock is available. Distinct from completion_rule action 'reallocate_remainder', which re-routes a remainder to another system that still has stock: the shortage policy applies only when the remainder cannot be covered anywhere. Declared once per order_type as the default; a single order may override it via order header 'shortage_policy', but only with a value listed in allowed_overrides. NORMATIVE: an engine MUST reject an order whose shortage_policy is neither the default nor in allowed_overrides.

default.description: Policy used when the order does not state one.

allowed_overrides.description: Further policies a single order may choose. Omit or leave empty to forbid overrides. Must not repeat the default.

allow_substitution.description: If true, before applying the policy the engine may fill the shortage with the item's substitute (MasterData-as-Code item lifecycle.substitute_item_id). Default false.

policy.description: backorder: ship what is available, keep the remainder open until stock arrives. ship_partial: ship what is available, cancel the remainder. hold: ship nothing until the whole order can be covered. cancel_line: cancel every short line completely, ship the other lines.
